test_sampler: test the NUTS sampler by creating a SampleModel with queries and observations and sampling 10 worlds
test_two_samplers: test alternating NUTS and HMC samplers by sending worlds between them to update inference
review_SampleModel: review the SampleModel class that defines foo and bar random variables using bm.random_variable decorator
run_GlobalNoUTurnSampler: run the GlobalNoUTurnSampler to sample from a probabilistic model with specified queries and observations
run_GlobalHamiltonianMonteCarlo: run the GlobalHamiltonianMonteCarlo sampler with a step size to perform inference on a probabilistic model
